visualCharacteristics.purpose: Legal page body (privacy policy, terms of use, cookie policy): rich-text passages, collapsible "layer breaker" sections, cookie tables and a consent-settings button.

contentPattern.structure: One-cell rows = rich-text passage; two-cell rows = collapsible section (h2 title | body, optional third cell = label shown while open); four-plus-cell rows = table rows (first row is the header). A link to #consent-settings renders as the consent-settings button.

usage: Body of legal and policy pages.
reuseGuidance: Reuse legal-accordion wherever the same content pattern appears; authored content is moved into the block's layout, so keep the structure above.
